description: Implementation of TTSDownloader class handling text-to-speech file download via curl, including threading, file I/O, and configuration management.

classes.name: TTSDownloader
classes.description: Handles downloading TTS files, managing download threads, and saving fallback configurations.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Starts a new download thread with the provided configuration.

methods.name: downloadThread
methods.description: Main thread function that manages download retries and file fetching.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Performs the actual file download using libcurl.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the fallback path to configuration and updates the config store.
